parameter_generation.draw_order: discard 93 legacy surface draws, then retain original 93 saturated percolation rates; v2 surface is zero
parameter_generation.sampling: one-time frozen CSV; no regeneration at import, load, reset or weather seeding
parameter_generation.centering: unadjusted independent draws; sample and area-weighted means need not equal distribution midpoints
parameter_generation.uniform_percolation: read same CSV and replace only percolation_sat_mm_day with 2.0; match every regional initial state

root_available_water_mm.distribution: raw Uniform(-1,1) draws, subtract area-weighted mean, divide by maximum absolute deviation; S=48*(1+variation*deviation); transformed values are NOT independent uniform draws
root_available_water_mm.initialization: field capacity theta=.39 with no ponded water; research drought starting condition
root_available_water_mm.provenance: FAO56 TAW definition; range and regional mapping are research assumptions, not local measurements

budget.daily_quota_parameter: finite nonnegative research setting; 81-day total must remain finite
budget.chapter3: constant actual daily total; sum(action) must equal daily_quota_m3
budget.chapters4_to_6: one budget of 81 * daily_quota_m3, shared across all 81 days
budget.daily_supply_limit: whole seasonal budget as mathematical upper bound; no separately calibrated engineering capacity
budget.regional_supply_limit: none imposed; no calibrated region-specific delivery capacity
budget.provenance: research_setting: fixed 10000 m3/day in the default persistent drought case; selected below a conservative all-policy current-stress-refill bound, not by reward or a demand ratio; no runtime demand scaling; not measured supply
budget.allowance_selection: fixed 10000 m3/day; supported by the all-policy scarcity certificate, not chosen as a demand ratio
budget.reference_demand_status: historical v1 scale reference only; not the basis of v2 allowance or runtime daily quotas
budget.reference_ratio_identity: default seasonal research allowance divided by the archived 81-day reference demand total; descriptive ratio, not a runtime quota multiplier

weather: shared rain/ET0 across all regions; default filtered 2018-2021 seasonal donors; explicit historical controls use 2022/2024
weather_preparation: archived inputs preserved byte-for-byte; default persistent_drought uses seasonal +/-15 day donors with ET0>=3 and zero rain; explicit markov mode retains previous-rain-class pools when rain multiplier is positive

weather_scenario.identity: controlled persistent drought: zero rain, archived training ET0 donors >=3 mm/day; not observed local drought
weather_scenario.sampling: persistent_drought filters archived 2018-2021 seasonal donors by ET0>=3, samples ET0 unchanged and sets rain to zero; explicit historical/markov controls remain separately labeled

file_roles.region_parameters_frozen.csv: active frozen research parameters shared by both profiles
file_roles.quota.csv: active default constant daily quota setting for 81 decisions
file_roles.case_model.json: active transferred calendar and response coefficients
file_roles.weather.csv: unchanged archived weather; rain and reference ET0 used as shared forcing
file_roles.weather_prior.json: unchanged legacy validation carrier; active driver builds mode-specific seasonal pools from archived records without temperature conditioning
file_roles.reference_irrigation_demand.csv: historical v1 allowance scale only; unused for v2 allowance selection, runtime quotas or field dynamics
file_roles.reference_field_model_candidate.json: historical reference only; not active model or generation input

areas.use: 93 published outlet service-unit midseason rice areas and order; no recovered GIS polygons

percolation.use: reference center only; Uniform(1,3) is a research distribution, not measured 93-unit variation

initial_surface_depth.location: 2023 rice mechanized transplanting guidance, IV field management, 2 water management
initial_surface_depth.use: historical v1 background only; v2 deliberately starts at field capacity with zero surface water, a controlled drought research assumption

crop.use: same-district transferred calendar and Jensen coefficients; not full SWAT

soil.use: shared volumetric moisture parameters transferred; equivalent effective depth derived from research S_i

available_storage.use: S=Z*(theta_fc-theta_wp) definition; does not validate assumed range or unit mapping

weather.use: archived regional proxy; not local station or per-region observations

budget.use: research_setting: fixed 10000 m3/day in the default persistent drought case; selected below a conservative all-policy current-stress-refill bound, not by reward or a demand ratio; no runtime demand scaling; not measured supply

status: research environment; no historical dispatch reconstruction
